q: How would you deploy a readmission risk model?
a: Score inpatients every few hours from EHR data in a secure environment, write scores and top factors back into the clinician's existing patient list, set the threshold by care-team capacity, run in silent mode first, monitor calibration, PPV and equity.
The model runs on live data and stores predictions without showing them, so clinicians can validate performance and tune thresholds before go-live.

q: Why can a successful clinical model look worse over time?
a: Interventions on flagged patients prevent the outcome, so those patients look like false positives. Record interventions and account for them in evaluation.

q: What is alert fatigue and how do you avoid it?
a: Clinicians ignore frequent, low-value alerts. Flag only as many patients as the team can act on, show reasons, integrate into existing screens, avoid interruptive pop-ups.
